subject: Library Podcast Class Trailers
overview: Medford Bytes presented trailers for three student podcasts developed during a Medford Public Library instructional course.

items.title: K-Dramarama
items.summary: Presented a trailer exploring the popularity, tropes, and cultural impact of South Korean television dramas.

items.title: Program Introduction
items.summary: Danielle Balocca introduced bonus content from the library's podcasting class and directed listeners to the show notes for event information.

items.title: I Agree, That Is Stupid
items.summary: Presented a trailer for a career-focused podcast that discusses workplace frustrations and offers professional coaching advice.

items.title: Disgruntled Tales
items.summary: Presented a fantasy-themed trailer featuring an interview between a host and an imprisoned dwarf in the Irmor Kingdom.
